WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P'), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS max_enrolled_students FROM Subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subq2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, max_enrolled_students FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ISBN, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), avg_units AS (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ISBN, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS units_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units AS a ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = a.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT s1.academic_year, s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.material_count, s1.min_term_code, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.ISBN, s2.units_deviation FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY s1.academic_year, s1.min_term_code

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.window_column

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.num_unique_subjects, icte.min_total_units, mfall.avg_total_units, mfall.var_total_units, mspring.max_spring_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS mfall ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mfall.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_spring_enrollment FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS mspring ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mspring.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), course_counts AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subject_code_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS cd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.window_column, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.avg_subject_codes, scs.stddev_subject_codes, cc.total_courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN subject_code_stats AS scs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scs.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN course_counts AS cc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, scs.avg_subject_codes DESC

WITH MathFallSubjects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY i.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), DeptUnitsStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mfs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mfs.num_subjects, mfs.TERM_START_DATE, mfs.TERM_END_DATE, NULL AS dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 'DeptUnitsStats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_DESCRIPTION, num_subjects, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT css.SUBJECT_TITLE, css.TERM_CODE, css.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, css.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, css.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, css.SCHOOL_NAME, css.max_num_enrolled_students, mts.min_academic_year, mts.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS css JOIN MathTermStats AS mts ON css.TERM_CODE = mts.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.max_num_enrolled_students, ic.min_academic_year, ic.avg_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ic.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.TERM_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P'), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS max_enrolled_students FROM Subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM Subq2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, max_enrolled_students FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ISBN, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), avg_units AS (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ISBN, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS units_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units AS a ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = a.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT s1.academic_year, s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.material_count, s1.min_term_code, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.ISBN, s2.units_deviation FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY s1.academic_year, s1.min_term_code

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON i.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID AND i.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.subject_count, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ISBN, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.subject_count DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.window_column

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.num_unique_subjects, icte.min_total_units, mfall.avg_total_units, mfall.var_total_units, mspring.max_spring_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS mfall ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mfall.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_spring_enrollment FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND cso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS mspring ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mspring.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), course_counts AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subject_code_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS cd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subjects JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.window_column, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.avg_subject_codes, scs.stddev_subject_codes, cc.total_courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN subject_code_stats AS scs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scs.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN course_counts AS cc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, scs.avg_subject_codes DESC

WITH MathFallSubjects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.num_subjects, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY i.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10), DeptUnitsStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mfs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mfs.num_subjects, mfs.TERM_START_DATE, mfs.TERM_END_DATE, NULL AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 'MathFallSubjects' AS Reason FROM MathFallSubjects AS mfs UNION ALL SELECT dus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS num_subjects, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TERM_END_DATE, dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 'DeptUnitsStats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_DESCRIPTION, num_subjects, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT css.SUBJECT_TITLE, css.TERM_CODE, css.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, css.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, css.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, css.SCHOOL_NAME, css.max_num_enrolled_students, mts.min_academic_year, mts.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS css JOIN MathTermStats AS mts ON css.TERM_CODE = mts.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.max_num_enrolled_students, ic.min_academic_year, ic.avg_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ic.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.TERM_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE

  SELECT
    ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_types_per_term_code
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at
  JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  WHERE at.TERM_CODE = '2023FA'
  GROUP BY ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
)

  ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  ccs.PREREQUISITES,
  tsc.subject_types_per_term_code,
  ccs.FALL_INSTRUCTORS AS instructor,

    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ccs2.SUBJECT_ID)
